source.description: SkillCorner and PySport open-data repository; 2024/25 Australian A-League broadcast tracking and dynamic events. Data are provider generated.
source.license_note: The repository includes a MIT LICENSE and README requests SkillCorner credit; no separate dataset-specific license file/terms was found in the inspected root files, so this records repository provenance rather than asserting an independent data license.

converter.target_quality: Provider-generated silver H/A labels with interruption-event-derived D and X uncertainty; no human labels used.

method.label_adapter: Pinned experiments/skillcorner_had.py; player-possession possession.group is H/A/null, null live gaps forward-filled, interruption-after event to next player possession yields D core with 1.0s X margins at each end. No D inferred from coordinate missingness.
method.visible_mask: sum(player_observed, axis=1) >= 12; player_observed comes from SkillCorner player is_detected == true.
method.preservation: X labels, ball_observed and player_observed masks, native 10Hz arrays and period/time gaps retained.

event_frame_integrity.tracking_frame_index_checked_by_converte: Every tracking row asserts frame == row index; converter also verifies 0.1s source timestamp steps within each half.
